newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline motors ahead then stalls before APIs.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline motors ahead then stalls before APIs.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended slightly higher on Wednesday, jumping early in the day with a rebound in crude futures and then stalling before U.S. inventory data out later today.
American Petroleum Institute's weekly supply report was delayed one day due to the Martin Luther King holiday.

U.S. traders expected the API to show a build of 1.70 million barrels after the previous week's increase of 415,000 barrels, which still kept total stocks of 196 million at a deficit of 9.3 million to a year ago.
Eurograde barges ended $4 higher at $217/$219 fob ARA with lesser traded regular unleaded at about an $8-$10 discount. Super unleaded was notionally valued $18 over Eurograde at $235/$237.
Eurograde dipped down during the day to trade twice at $216.50, one broker said, before edging higher late in the day as IPE Brent futures posted a 25-cent gain from Tuesday.
